blocks.text: In Kaziranga, Assam, I followed the places where grassland, trees and water meet. Asian openbills stand in a narrow channel; northern pintails feed on a broad pool; a rhinoceros grazes through tall grass; an elephant is half seen in water. The series moves between close encounters and wider views to show that each animal is part of a living place. All photographs were made on my visit in February 2026. They are original camera photographs with only light tonal editing; no animals were baited or disturbed. This is a personal visual record, not a claim that the images prove habitat change.
